provenance: Expected rows are the documented LATERAL semantics of the referenced engines (see source_docs); this fixture pins Alopex against that reference and is not a recording of an external engine run.
setup: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE s (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, t_id INTEGER, val INTEGER); INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2); INSERT INTO s VALUES (10, 1, 100), (11, 1, 200)

cases.name: cross_join_lateral_top_one_per_row
cases.sql: SELECT t.id, l.val FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.val FROM s WHERE s.t_id = t.id ORDER BY s.val DESC LIMIT 1) AS l ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: left_join_lateral_pads_unmatched_left_row
cases.sql: SELECT t.id, l.val FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.val FROM s WHERE s.t_id = t.id ORDER BY s.val DESC LIMIT 1) AS l ON TRUE ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: lateral_aggregate_returns_one_row_per_left_row
cases.sql: SELECT t.id, m.mx FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(s.val) AS mx FROM s WHERE s.t_id = t.id) AS m ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: lateral_join_condition_filters_correlated_rows
cases.sql: SELECT t.id, l.val FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.val FROM s WHERE s.t_id = t.id) AS l ON l.val > 150 ORDER BY t.id

cases.name: lateral_cross_join_expands_every_correlated_row
cases.sql: SELECT t.id, l.val FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.val FROM s WHERE s.t_id = t.id) AS l ORDER BY t.id, l.val

cases.name: relation_alias_column_list_renames_a_base_table
cases.sql: SELECT p.a, p.c FROM s AS p(a, b, c) ORDER BY p.a
